text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), leukopenia (low white blood cells), lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and relative monocytosis and basophilia. Red cell parameters and biochemistry are within normal limits. These findings may suggest an acute or chronic infectious or inflammatory process, possibly viral, and warrant further clinical correlation and follow-up.
